The '''Multi-environment Space Boat''' was a space [[Transport/Legends|transport]] also capable of traveling in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and underwater. The [[Explorer (space boat)|''Explorer'']] was a modified Multi-environment Space Boat.

==Appearances==
*''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''
